paper.title_en: From bulk flows to boundary generators and costs
paper.abstract_en: Holographic complexity admits a broad family of bulk observables, yet their relation to boundary state-preparation costs remains unclear. We propose a local prescription that associates suitable bulk observables with quadratic cost geometries on families of states prepared by Euclidean sources. Building on the holographic transport of bulk Hamiltonian flows to Euclidean preparation sources, we use the Hessian of the transported generator at a stationary reference state to define a candidate cost metric. When this Hessian is positive definite, the minimised preparation energy reproduces the change in the bulk observable to quadratic order. We characterise the resulting preparation penalties relative to the Fubini-Study metric and compute them for the maximal volume in scalar perturbations of AdS$_3$. At large-conformal dimension, we recover the known proportionality between cost and Fubini-Study metrics. At finite dimension, we obtain positive but generally unequal penalties for source variations that displace the bulk field and its conjugate momentum, breaking this proportionality even for a single scalar operator. We further study a deformation of volume by quadratic scalar and gradient terms in the large-dimension regime, determining how the couplings modify the penalties and constrain positivity. These additions selectively change field-displacement costs, with the gradient term introducing mode dependence. Our results provide an explicit local connection between the choice of bulk observables and the assignment of boundary preparation penalties.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文提出将体观测量与边界态制备的二次代价几何相联系的局部处方，涉及全息复杂性、Fubini-Study 度规比较及 AdS$_3$ 标量扰动下的显式计算，理论深度较高且问题明确，值得进一步阅读；因论文较新、引用数为零，不计社区信号。
decision.title_zh: 从体流到边界生成元与代价
decision.abstract_zh: 全息复杂性容许一大类体观测量，但它们与边界态制备代价之间的关系仍不清楚。我们提出一种局部处方，将合适的体观测量与由欧几里得源制备的态族上的二次代价几何联系起来。基于体哈密顿流的全息输运至欧几里得制备源，我们利用输运生成元在稳定参考态处的 Hessian 定义候选代价度规。当该 Hessian 为正定时，最小化制备能量在二次阶上重现体观测量的变化。我们刻画所得制备惩罚相对于 Fubini-Study 度规的性质，并在 AdS$_3$ 的标量扰动中针对最大体积进行计算。在大共形维数下，我们恢复了代价与 Fubini-Study 度规之间已知的比例关系。在有限维数下，对于使体场及其共轭动量发生位移的源变化，我们得到正但一般不相等的惩罚，即使对单个标量算符也破坏了这一比例关系。我们进一步在大维数区域研究由二次标量项与梯度项对体积的形变，确定耦合如何修改惩罚并约束正定性。这些附加项选择性地改变场位移代价，其中梯度项引入模式依赖性。我们的结果为体观测量的选择与边界制备惩罚的赋值之间提供了显式的局部联系。
